messages.subject: Cedarbridge Business Park, Reading - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Following our call last week, we'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter on the acquisition of Cedarbridge Business Park in Reading. We've agreed heads in principle with Westgate Trust Estates at £14.25m. Isla Fournier is leading internally and will be your day-to-day contact alongside Rebecca on the funding side.

Can you send across an engagement letter and your AML requirements?

Daniel

Daniel Quigley
Managing Director, Thornbury Properties Limited

messages.subject: RE: Cedarbridge Business Park, Reading - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Delighted to act. Our engagement letter is attached - James Osei (copied) will have day-to-day conduct, with Elena Marchetti supporting. Please sign and return the duplicate, and our compliance team will be in touch about source of funds for the £14.25m (we understand cash reserves plus the Pennine facility).

We'll open the file as Project Cedar and start reviewing the Birchall Stone contract package as soon as it arrives.

Best regards,
Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
